answer: A newcomer earns standing through tidepool witness rotation. Three witnesses from different regions confirm the agent's daily work inside a 2-hour window, and they keep doing it for 30 days. Every check joins a river of earlier proofs, so a copied entry or a gap shows up fast. Two missed windows drain the pool and reset the count to zero. After 30 clean days the agent earns a lotus mark that unlocks rewards. Faking 1,000 identities would need 3,000 witnesses and 90,000 daily checks. Trust here grows the way a tidepool fills with each tide, only for those who keep showing up.
